use_cases: Displaying product or service categories with icons and descriptions
Creating navigation menus for content organization
Building filtering interfaces for e-commerce or content sites
Showcasing feature lists with visual hierarchy
Implementing expandable category sections in dashboards
ai_summary: A customizable category list component with hover interactions and optional icons. Features a centered header with gradient accent, followed by a vertically stacked list of clickable category items with smooth transitions. Designed for browsing and selecting from categorized content or navigation hierarchies.
